Context: 11. T.A. on Retirement

2. T.A. not admissible on resignation, dismissal, etc.The concession is admissible only to persons who retire on retiring pension or on superannuation, invalid or compensation pension. It is not admissible to employees who quit service by resignation or who may be dismissed or removed from service. The concession is also not admissible to persons who are compulsorily retired as a measure of punishment. GIO (1), SR 147.
